decision_rule.primary_evidence: Every rendered message was read together with its frozen behavior ledger, persona variant, event phase, and synthetic parent message where applicable, then compared qualitatively with the held-out real shock-window posts and linked replies.
diagnostic_only: emoji, repetition, slang, and formal-marker shares
decision_rule.reply_semantics: A reply is judged with its parent. It must retain the core stance and reply function, but need not restate every secondary clause from the canonical standalone wording.
decision_rule.explicit_nonrule: No composite mechanical naturalness score determines acceptance.

iteration_history.reason: Rendered replies had a 36-character median because the judge preferred complete canonical restatements.
Length-bucket generation worked, but the judge still treated omission of secondary clauses as semantic failure; reply median remained 32 characters.
All 16 cases preserve the auditable behavioral core; 11 clearly improve surface realism, 5 are partial but non-regressive, and parent-conditioned replies reach a credible short-form distribution.

remaining_limits: The lecture behavior panel still underrepresents amplification, evidence relaying, irony, and collective pile-on visible in the held-out real window.
Synthetic parents are selected from prior-phase public messages by topic; the supplied tables do not identify a complete direct-reply graph.
The comment collection regime changes around April, so cascade depth, propagation speed, and response latency remain nonclaims.
Sixteen cases validate the architecture and first renderer, not full 48-agent integration or every archetype-phase combination.
